producer.name: Codex
producer.role: HOST-002 local Claude CLI probe operator

criterion: On the installed Claude CLI, a plugin skill with disable-model-invocation true is hidden from model-triggered invocation while remaining explicitly invocable by the user.

source.observed_outcome: The unguarded control called Skill(host002-canary:visibility-canary) and received the body-only marker. The otherwise identical guarded plugin made no Skill call and returned NOT_VISIBLE. Explicit /host002-canary:visibility-canary invocation returned the marker.

isolation.workspace: clean committed checkout snapshot plus disposable external plugin directories and empty workspace
isolation.network: Anthropic model API through the already-authenticated local Claude CLI

limitations: The verdict is build-specific to Claude Code 2.1.243 and does not erase older counter-evidence or establish other hosts.
The canary verifies plugin-skill invocation visibility, not the manual-only skills' body-level approval and effect boundaries.
The paired unguarded control hit an operator-selected post-dispatch budget after the Skill call and body injection, so its final response did not complete.
